# 1. GOODS

Canadian and United States wheat in bulk, of fair average quality of the season's
shipment at time and place of shipment.

# 13. PAYMENT

## (a) Terms

Payment shall be made in cash within five business days against shipping documents.

## (b) Shipping documents

Shipping documents shall consist of invoice, bill of lading, and policy of insurance.

# 20. ARBITRATION

Any dispute arising out of this contract shall be settled by arbitration in
accordance with GAFTA Arbitration Rules No. 125.
